Canonical status reads only requested IDs via repeated ids parameters, includeRemoved=true, account-scoped campaigns. Delivery status and deliveryStatusReasons.code are documented; known review-not-approved codes produce deduplicated descriptions, unknown evidence stays unknown. Daily reporting exists via asynchronous pfreports with breakdown.time=DAY. Report calendar timezone and cost scale remain unconfirmed; R3 implements report.metrics.v1 with impressions/clicks and null spend, provisional/stale days labelled in the discovered account timezone. Canonical status discovers country/currency/timezone from authenticated group accounts, supports TW/TH and uses the host deadline, with 500ms spacing between requests.

POST account pfreports returns Report; poll collection with ids filter, page=1,size=1; download pfreports/{id}/download. Query uses ADACCOUNT/CAMPAIGN/ADGROUP/AD, since/until display dates, breakdown.time=DAY, filtering={idType:ADACCOUNT,ids:[accountId]}, includeRemove=true, fileFormat=CSV and locale=en. Status: CREATED/PREPARING/ERROR/READY. CSV is UTF-8; CSV_EXCEL is not requested. OM subtracts one day from its exclusive end. Fresh custody/signing and the existing streamed 1MiB body cap cover every request. csv-parse handles BOM/quotes/strict columns. Exact CSV headers, cost units and report-day timezone are unverified; account/currency columns are not trusted or required.
